hamburg-north-german-escapes-mecklenburg.title: Mecklenburg Lakes and Schwerin Arc
hamburg-north-german-escapes-mecklenburg.slogan: A 448 km loop out of Hamburg east
hamburg-north-german-escapes-mecklenburg.story: Lakes, castles and gentle sweepers east of Hamburg. Out of Glinde and back again: 448 km, roughly 9 h 20 in the saddle. The stops in between: Lauenburg, Schwerin castle sight, Plauer See water stop and Wismar harbour. The line favours views over speed.
